description.message: Send a download link to your local ZipZap application.

sent.message: Added to the ZipZap queue. A held queue waits until you start it. This does not mean the download is complete.

received.message: Received locally. Waiting for ZipZap to confirm the queue.

timeout.message: ZipZap has not confirmed in time. The request may still be queued; check the app before sending again.

protocol.message: The local host could not confirm this request. Update ZipZap and reconnect the browser in Settings.

destination.message: Not queued: that filename is occupied. Open ZipZap and review a different filename.

app_rejected.message: Not queued: ZipZap rejected the request. Open the app to check the link, destination and queue limits.

app_start_failed.message: ZipZap could not start. Open or repair the app, then check its queue before sending again.

expired.message: The local receipt is unavailable or expired. Check ZipZap before sending again.

missing.message: Open ZipZap and connect the browser in Settings.

invalid.message: Use an HTTP/HTTPS link without embedded credentials.

privacy.message: No page tracking. No cookies exported. Explicit links only.

inbox_full.message: Not received: the local inbox is full. Open ZipZap and check pending requests before sending again.

host_rejected.message: The local host could not confirm receipt. Open ZipZap, check its queue and available storage, then reconnect the browser.

healthHost.message: Extension and local host connected. The app has no recent readiness signal; open ZipZap and check again. No download was started.

healthReady.message: Extension and local host connected. ZipZap was recently ready. No download was started.

healthTimeout.message: Connection check timed out. Open or repair ZipZap and try again. No download request was sent.

captureHelp.message: Optional site access for public file clicks and video buttons. Keep the page open until ZipZap confirms. Sign-in downloads and protected streams are unsupported.

captureReload.message: Saved. Reload the site to apply page access. Accepted downloads stay in ZipZap.

captureSettingsError.message: Could not save site access. Check extension permissions and try again.

captureDenied.message: Site access was declined. Normal browser downloads remain available.

captureNoSite.message: Open a normal HTTP(S) page, then open this popup. Private browsing is excluded.

capturePreparing.message: Preparing this link. No download has been queued yet.

captureQueued.message: Added to ZipZap. The app queue controls when it starts.

captureFallback.message: ZipZap did not take this download. Returned to the browser.

captureUnknown.message: The app may own this download. Check this request or open ZipZap before trying again. No browser copy was started.

videoHide.message: Hide video buttons on this site

videoShow.message: Show video buttons on this site

videoPopup.message: Find a video on this page

videoHelp.message: Public MP4/WebM and available combined YouTube MP4. Save only when the site and rights holder allow it. Other streaming formats are unsupported.

videoPreparing.message: Checking the public video source. Nothing is queued yet.

videoCancelled.message: Preparation cancelled. This page will not activate that request.

videoUnavailable.message: This video was not added. A public MP4/WebM or combined YouTube MP4 may be unavailable; update or repair ZipZap if its tools are missing. No browser copy was started.

videoNoSource.message: No supported source is available here. Enable site access, show video buttons and reload. Cross-origin frames or native fullscreen may require returning to the main page.

videoPageStatus.message: See the ZipZap message on the page for confirmation or recovery.

video_unavailable.message: A public combined video is unavailable. Check supported sources or repair the app.
